business_problem: Stax.ai needed to tame fragmented unstructured retirement-plan data and replace slow manual document handling that could not scale across thousands of plans.
solution_summary: Stax.ai built its retirement-administration platform on MongoDB Atlas running with Google Cloud so it could ingest brokerage statements, payroll information, and client files without forcing them into rigid schemas. Atlas gives the team a flexible document store for diverse retirement-plan records, while Google Cloud supplies the processing capacity to handle tens of thousands of documents each day and support AI-driven extraction workflows. The combined design turns messy source documents into automated data-management and compliance workflows instead of manual handoffs. As a result, Stax.ai cut processing times from days to hours or minutes, improved accuracy and efficiency, and scaled operations without taking on more infrastructure work.
